# Skill validator

Unmodified `quick_validate.py` from OpenAI's `skill-creator` skill, distributed under the accompanying Apache-2.0 license. Source: https://github.com/openai/skills/tree/main/skills/.system/skill-creator.

This copy keeps local and future CI checks independent of a Codex installation. Python 3 and PyYAML are required; install the pinned dependency from `scripts/requirements-skills.txt`. Update the validator deliberately alongside its license.
